hooks.command: FAIL=""; FAIL_OUT=""; if ! OUT=$(npm run lint 2>&1); then FAIL="lint (npm run lint) — fix TypeScript errors"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:numinput 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:numinput — Number(e.target.value) sneaked in; use NumberInput component"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:secdef-null-tenant 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:secdef-null-tenant — SECDEF RPC inserts with NULL tenant_id (CP1 regression)"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:csp-backend-allowlist 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:csp-backend-allowlist — serve.json CSP connect-src missing a backend hostname used by src/lib/backendUrl.ts (browser will block getBackendUrl fetches)"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:no-string-err-fallback 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:no-string-err-fallback — err instanceof Error ? .message : String(err) sneaked in; Supabase PostgrestError renders as [object Object]. Use extractErrorMessage() from src/lib/extractErrorMessage.ts"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:secdef-auth-schema-owner 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:secdef-auth-schema-owner — SECURITY DEFINER function references auth.* but is owned by vosi_rpc_owner; fails at runtime with 'permission denied for schema auth' (SQLSTATE 42501). Use OWNER TO postgres."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:hardcoded-color-hex 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:hardcoded-color-hex — new inline hex color added above 1031 baseline. Add hex to token catalog in src/index.css OR reduce elsewhere."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:spacing-off-scale 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:spacing-off-scale — new off-scale Tailwind spacing (p-5, p-7, gap-9, etc.) above 185 baseline. Use canonical scale (p-4, p-6, gap-4)."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:radius-non-canonical 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:radius-non-canonical — rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl regression. Use 'rounded' (4px, Tailwind default) or 'rounded-full' if semantic circular."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:hardcoded-empty-state 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:hardcoded-empty-state — new file with inline 'Belum ada'/'Tidak ada' text. Use <EmptyState /> from src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npm run audit:slog-any-error 2>&1); then FAIL="audit:slog-any-error — slog.Any('error', err) in backend-go renders as 'error={}' in prod logs (Go equivalent of [object Object] class-error). Use slog.String('error', err.Error())."; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -z "$FAIL" ] && ! OUT=$(npx vitest run --changed 2>&1); then FAIL="vitest --changed — tests affected by your changes are failing"; FAIL_OUT="$OUT"; fi; if [ -n "$FAIL" ]; then printf '%s' "$FAIL_OUT" | tail -100 | jq -Rs --arg check "$FAIL" '{decision:"block", reason:("Gate failed: " + $check + ". Fix before finishing the turn — do NOT disable this hook. If mid-refactor with intentional WIP, run /hooks to disable for one turn only:\n" + .)}'; fi
